paite: Kitamgawpsakpa doutu na mai ah ahong pawt hi; kigalthuam inla, na lampi veng in, na kawng khauhsak inla na thilhihtheihna hattak in bawlhoih in.
heading: Nineveh Pukna Leh Siatgawpna
english: He who dashes in pieces has come up against you. Keep the fortress! Watch the way! Strengthen your waist! Fortify your power mightily!

paite: Hihse mite'n Israel thupina hihsia in agrep guite hihtan mah le uh, TOUPA Jakobte thupina ama a bang in atungding nawn ngal ding ahi.
english: For Yahweh restores the excellency of Jacob, as the excellency of Israel; for the destroyers have destroyed them, and ruined their vine branches.

paite: Amihatte lum sansak ahi a, mihangsante asan-au in akivan ua; akisakna ni in kangtalaite kahpasik tet in ate kelkel ua, teipite mulkimhuaitak in aphe zolzol hi.
english: The shield of his mighty men is made red. The valiant men are in scarlet. The chariots flash with steel in the day of his preparation, and the pine spears are brandished.

paite: Kangtalaite kongzing ah atai gomgom a; lamlian zate ah akiphu noknok ua; meisel bang in alang ua, khophia bang in atai zualzual uhi.
english: The chariots rage in the streets. They rush back and forth in the broad ways. Their appearance is like torches. They run like the lightnings.

paite: Amiliante atheigige a; apai lai un akisuipai ua; baang lam zuan in akinoh ua, kihumbitna ding abawl uhi.
english: He summons his picked troops. They stumble on their way. They dash to its wall, and the protective shield is put in place.

paite: Lui kongkhakte hon ahi a, kumpipa' inn hihsiat in a-om hi.
english: The gates of the rivers are opened, and the palace is dissolved.

paite: Huan Huzzab salmat in apaimangpih ua, asikhanute'n a-awm uh tum in vakhu bang a ham in akah uhi.
english: It is decreed: she is uncovered, she is carried away; and her handmaids moan as with the voice of doves, beating on their breasts.

paite: Nidanglai a kipan Nineveh khua zaw dil a tui luangkhia bang ahi; himahleh ami tampi ataikhe ding ua, khawl in, khawl in, chi in kikou mah le uh kuamah akihei kei ding uh.
english: But Nineveh has been from of old like a pool of water, yet they flee away. “Stop! Stop!” they cry, but no one looks back.

paite: Dangkasik gallak in laksak unla unla, dangka-eng leng gallak in laksak un; gou manpha a dim ahih ziak in thil kisekkhawm leh vanhoihte tawi bei ni anei kei ding hi.
english: Take the spoil of silver. Take the spoil of gold, for there is no end of the store, the glory of all goodly furniture.

paite: Sukvuak in a-om a, avuak keuhkeuh a, asiang sipsip; lungtang azulmang a, khukte akihot ua, kawng tengteng ana tuntun a, amelte amual khin vek hi.
english: She is empty, void, and waste. The heart melts, the knees knock together, their bodies and faces have grown pale.

paite: Humpinelkai khosakna mun, humpinelkai pite leh anoute nek ding abalnenna leh alausak ding om lou a humpinelkai leh humpinelkai tekte pai vialvialna koi mun hita ahia?
english: Where is the den of the lions, and the feeding place of the young lions, where the lion and the lioness walked, the lion’s cubs, and no one made them afraid?

paite: Humpinelkai tal in anoute kham khop abotnen a, humpinelkai pite a ding in akeilum a, akokhukte uh sa keih in adimsak a, a-omna kokhuk samatte in adimsak hi.
english: The lion tore in pieces enough for his cubs, and strangled for his lionesses, and filled his caves with the kill, and his dens with prey.

paite: Sepaihte' TOUPA'N, "Ngai dih, ka hon dou ahi, akangtalaite ka halkhu vungvung ding a, na humpinelkai noute namsau in ahihmang ding; lei a na sa keih ka sutawp ding a, na palaite aw zak ahi nawnta kei ding," achi hi.
english: “Behold, I am against you,” says Yahweh of Armies, “and I will burn her chariots in the smoke, and the sword will devour your young lions; and I will cut off your prey from the earth, and the voice of your messengers will no longer be heard.”
